briefs: Use case: historical-scene / illustration-story. Create ONE high-resolution 3840x2160 cinematic storyboard sheet for a Chinese classroom animated film of Li Bai's 望庐山瀑布. EXACT 2 by 2 equal rectangular panels, four distinct full-bleed landscape illustrations, each panel 16:9, precisely aligned at the center horizontal and vertical boundaries; absolutely NO gutters, borders, lettering, calligraphy, logos, captions or text. Each panel must stand alone as a usable movie shot. Style: premium hand-painted Chinese ink-and-color animation background, delicate gouache, atmospheric perspective, rich jade greens, cobalt shadows, warm dawn gold, cinematic detailed luminous mist, immersive not flat icon illustration. Same Lushan Xiufeng mountain setting and consistent environment in all 4 shots. TOP LEFT: huge distant view, rising sun shining on incense-burner-shaped high peak, violet mist rising from valley, lone Tang poet tiny on rock in foreground looking upward. TOP RIGHT: closer view of tall silver waterfall like a white ribbon hanging between jade cliffs, vapor, pine branches framing foreground, enormous scale. BOTTOM LEFT: low angle from base looking up at powerful white falling cascade, spray and foaming water, dynamic sense of vertical speed. BOTTOM RIGHT: poetic imaginative night transition, waterfall seems a glowing Milky Way descending from a deep indigo star-filled sky into the mountain valley, dreamlike but clearly landscape. All panel compositions have generous dark/quiet lower 20% for later subtitles (do NOT add subtitles). No modern buildings, cranes, tourists, powerlines or anachronisms. This is historical poetic visualization, not a real photo.

Use case: historical-scene / illustration-story. Create ONE high-resolution 3840x2160 cinematic storyboard sheet for a Chinese classroom animated film of Du Fu's 春望, Chang'an in spring 757 during the An Lushan rebellion. EXACT 2 by 2 equal rectangular panels, four distinct full-bleed landscape illustrations each 16:9, precisely aligned at center horizontal and vertical boundaries; absolutely NO gutters, borders, lettering, calligraphy, captions, watermarks, logos or text. Each panel must stand alone as a usable movie shot. Style: premium hand-painted historical Chinese animation backgrounds, detailed gouache and expressive ink, muted warm ochre, blue gray, pale dusty rose flowers, melancholy cinematic atmosphere. Same Du Fu in all shots when visible: middle-aged Chinese scholar about 45 years old, thin face and short dark/gray beard, humble worn brown Tang robe and cloth headwrap, no costume from later dynasties. TOP LEFT: wide Chang'an city walls and old Tang tiled roofs partially damaged, spring mountains remain under overcast sky, streets overgrown with grasses, one tiny distant curl of smoke, no modern skyline. TOP RIGHT: close-up delicate spring plum blossoms with rain/dew, a tiny perched bird, subdued city ruins beyond, flowers beautiful but poignant, no human facial closeups. BOTTOM LEFT: inside dim humble room, Du Fu seated at wooden desk gazing at a handwritten folded family letter with blank/illegible marks, window opens toward faraway small beacon smoke on mountain ridge; no blood, bodies or graphic battle. BOTTOM RIGHT: medium side-back view of Du Fu by open wooden window, one hand gently touching thinning gray hair, lonely silhouette against persistent spring mountains and late dusk, tender sorrow and dignity. Lower 20% quiet/darker for later captions (do not add captions). Historically plausible Tang architecture, emotionally moving, no battle spectacle, no fantasy dragons, no graphic suffering.

Use case: historical-scene / illustration-story. Create ONE high-resolution 3840x2160 cinematic storyboard sheet for a Chinese classroom animated film of Su Shi's 念奴娇·赤壁怀古. EXACT 2 by 2 equal rectangular panels, four distinct full-bleed landscape illustrations each 16:9, precisely aligned at center horizontal and vertical boundaries; absolutely NO gutters, borders, lettering, calligraphy, captions, watermarks, logos or text. Each panel must stand alone as usable film shot. Style: premium historical Chinese hand-painted animation, expressive ink with layered watercolor/gouache, deep teal river, ochre cliffs, indigo night, silver moonlight, cinematic enormous scale, nuanced atmospheric perspective. TOP LEFT: Northern Song scholar Su Shi about 45, broad calm face dark beard, simple gray-blue robe and black cloth cap, standing on a rocky Huangzhou river bank, rear three-quarter view, Yangtze flowing toward misty horizon. TOP RIGHT: dramatic close view of rugged red-ochre cliffs and foaming waves crashing at rock base, flying white spray like snow, distant treetops. BOTTOM LEFT: clearly idealized historical reverie of youthful Zhou Yu in Three Kingdoms era, elegant composed commander holding feather fan wearing scholar-like silk headcloth, foreground on wooden boat, rows of ancient wooden ships and remote fire glow in mist far behind, NO blood/no graphic combat; distinguish this warm golden memory palette from cool Song present. BOTTOM RIGHT: return to Su Shi on a small wooden boat beneath luminous full moon above wide river and cliffs, pouring a small cup of wine into river as poetic salute, peaceful reflective silver-blue night, no temple modern roofs. Lower 20% quiet/dark for later subtitles. No modern props, no dragon boats, no imperial throne or Ming/Qing costumes. Huangzhou scenic location is an artistic literary setting, not asserted to be actual battle site.
